name: weather-aware-truck-routing
description: Haulcast monorepo task runner: delegates to backend/ (uv) and frontend/ (pnpm).

scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: bash scripts/dev-db.sh run uv run --directory backend pytest --cov --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.test:scripts: uv run --no-project --with pytest python -m pytest scripts/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
